goal: Continue the original GLM5.3 W8A8C8 PD optimization objective; deployment, backup, PR and phase summaries are not stopping conditions.

prefix_conditions: unique per-request salt after connection warmup
per-client salt reuse after full warmup
stage_order: one mechanism candidate with matched protocol

controls: no profiler, payload audit, archive or full weight hash during formal timing
correctness: HTTP200 and exactly64 output token IDs
leading arithmetic result numerically5 for throughput fixtures; format variants retained
12 extra arithmetic task checks and protected baseline-passing subset in candidate comparison
exact token/format variation separate from functional/target precision evidence; not full model accuracy claim

first_candidate.mechanism: Official MTP one draft token with eager draft and FULL_DECODE_ONLY target
first_candidate.hypothesis: Amortize target replay/TP communication and weight reads across accepted output tokens; draft is one existing model layer, no new kernel.
first_candidate.topology_gate: Check whether P and D MTP cache specs must match; use supported native configuration rather than custom mappings.
first_candidate.acceptance: Paired repeat improvement exceeds measured baseline noise, no protected task regression, SDMA maintained; report TTFT/TPOT and C1/C4 throughput including regressions.
